descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The bat is already in your hand. A pitcher winds up on the mound and throws you real pitches. Swing for real - the harder and cleaner the swing, the further the ball flies.

FOUR PLACES TO PLAY
- The Moon: one-sixth gravity sends a good swing more than a thousand feet while Earth hangs in the sky. Distance signs mark your drive, and hitting the lunar lander scores bonus points.
- Skyscraper Roof: a turf diamond 300 metres above a glowing sunset city. Knock it clean off the roof, or smash the water tower and the HIT ME billboard.
- Stickball Street: a sunny Brooklyn block where distance is counted in sewers. Three sewers is a home run - and the brownstone windows really break.
- Night Stadium: a ballpark under the lights. Clear the fence and fireworks light up the sky.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Pick a place from the start menu and switch any time.
- Every hit is measured in feet on the board beside you, and your best distance is saved for each place.
- Home runs pop a big banner; targets score bonus points.
- Choose the pitch speed from 25 to 60 mph.
- Six music tracks with volume control.
- Snap turning and a menu that pauses the pitcher.

Single player, standing or roomscale, no internet connection required.
